key_insight: Indoor photovoltaics paired with (anti)ferroelectric energy storage and low-power computing could enable autonomous edge AI nodes that reduce reliance on centralized data centres.
engineering_relevance: Reliable distributed intelligence requires co-designing indoor energy harvesting, storage and computation so local power supply matches device demand.
method: Review indoor photovoltaic requirements and emerging materials for distributed intelligence.

evidence_signal: The abstract describes a perspective on material opportunities and system requirements, not a quantitative evaluation or demonstrated integrated device.
